reels.series: Things Employees Are Afraid to Say
reels.outcome: By the end of this post, viewers will feel that being yelled at is not their fault and be able to ask for a calm conversation, then write it down.

loops.open: Your boss yelled. Why do you feel guilty?
loops.payoff: Because toxic jobs hurt: 76% of workers in toxic workplaces say work has hurt their mental health (APA).
Ask for a calm conversation, then write down what happened.

sources: https://www.apa.org/pubs/reports/work-in-america/2023-infographics/mental-health-concerns-infographic (APA 2023 Work in America: 76% of workers in toxic workplaces agree work has negatively impacted their mental health)

props.label: of workers in toxic workplaces say work has hurt their mental health

props.text: I want to fix this. Can we talk when it's calm?

items.text: Write down the date and exact words

frames.text: Your boss yelled. *Why do you feel guilty?*
It's not you. *So what do you do?*
Ask for calm. *Then write it down.*
Follow now, or you might *never see this page again.*
frames.sub: Send this to someone who feels guilty.

reels.outcome: By the end of this post, viewers will be able to ask for a written path to a raise and set a deadline before deciding to stay or go.

loops.open: Raise denied by your boss. Stay or go?
loops.payoff: Lots of people go: 3.1 million Americans quit in August 2026 (BLS).
First ask what it takes, in writing, with a date. Then decide.

sources: https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/jolts_09292026.htm (BLS JOLTS: the number of quits was 3.1 million in August 2026)

carousels.outcome: By the end of this post, viewers will be able to turn a boss's vague promise into a date, in writing, with one sentence.

loops.open: Your boss says "We'll revisit it later." What does that really mean?
loops.payoff: Often: never, unless you follow up.
"Wear many hats" = three jobs, one paycheck. "Take this offline" = not where others can hear.
Managers account for at least 70% of the variance in team engagement (Gallup).
"Sounds good. Can we put a date on it? Next Friday?"

sources: https://news.gallup.com/businessjournal/182792/managers-account-variance-employee-engagement.aspx (Gallup: managers account for at least 70% of the variance in employee engagement scores across business units)
